content: iOS WebRTC audio: getUserMedia switches audio session to play-and-record; output route speaker vs earpiece not controllable (no setSinkId/enumerateDevices outputs on iOS); navigator.audioSession API partial in Safari 16.4+; installed PWAs lose mic when backgrounded/locked; camera permission re-prompts in standalone on route/hash changes; remote audio elements need play() inside user gesture; dynamically created elements may stay blocked.
